translations.web: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.
translations.bsb: Your hand will be lifted over your foes, and all your enemies will be cut off.
translations.kjv: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.
translations.asv: Let thy hand be lifted up above thine adversaries, and let all thine enemies be cut off.
